text: Ava (Design): Quick design ask — looking at the trace viewer when it collapses into the compact toolbar at narrow widths. I'm trying to declutter the left of the panel; thinking of moving Export and Copy-ID into the kebab menu and keeping only Jump/Collapse/Pin visible. Thoughts? :thinking: Marcus (Product): I'd prefer Copy-ID stay visible — customers often grab the correlation/request id quickly during support. Export could be hidden. Riley (Eng Runtime): Agree with Marcus. Copy is a cheap click and we should keep it 1-tap. Also want to call out keyboard affordance — the visible copy button should have a keyboard focus and shortcut (e.g., C) when the trace is selected. Sam (Accessibility): Strong +1 to keyboard focus, but we need to ensure we expose the control with an accessible name. "Copy correlation ID" is clearer than just "Copy". For screen readers: aria-label needs to include the request id context, eg: `aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID 4a7f... to clipboard\"` so it reads as a single actionable thing. Ava (Design): Good point on verbose label. I worry about visual noise if we show full id in label — that should only be in sr-only copy. Visual button label remains an icon. Riley (Eng Runtime): Implementation note: we can use aria-describedby to attach the full id to the button for SRs instead of changing visible text. Also we should add `role=\"button\"` and make sure Enter/Space triggers it. Sam (Accessibility): aria-describedby works. Also add an aria-live polite region for a confirmation message like 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard' — some screen readers don't pick up clipboard events otherwise. Marcus (Product): Small copy tweak: across the console we use "Request ID" rather than "Correlation ID" in user-facing places. We should be consistent. Which term do we standardize on? Ava (Design): We debated that before — ops folks like "Correlation ID" but product/support prefer "Request ID". For the toolbar I vote for "Request ID" (shorter and less jargon). We can keep internal labeling as correlation_id in code. Riley (Eng Runtime): No problem on backend. We'll map the display copy. Quick question: if we put Copy-ID on the primary toolbar, there's reduced space for the timeline zoom buttons. Would toggling to an overflow menu when viewport < 520px make sense? Ava (Design): Yes — breakpoint-based behavior. Visible primary actions: Pin, Collapse/Expand, Copy Request ID. Everything else goes into kebab. Export, Download HAR, Open in New Tab -> kebab. Sam (Accessibility): Ensure the kebab menu is reachable by keyboard and that menu items are announced with the role listbox/option pattern (or menu/menuitem) and have aria-checked where appropriate. Also focus should move into the menu when opened and return to the toggle when closed. Marcus (Product): UX decision: when Copy Request ID is used in compact mode, show a small snackbar: 'Request ID copied • Copy link' — the link could be a quick permalink. That saves clicks. Riley (Eng Runtime): Snackbars are fine but ensure they are dismissible and don't steal focus. For screen readers, add `aria-live=polite` text for the snackbar; visually we can animate in/out. Ava (Design): Putting this together: visual spec — icon-only Copy button with tooltip "Copy Request ID"; sr-only text for full id; visible snackbar with 'Request ID copied' and an in-snackbar small 'Copy link' action. On narrow screens, keep Copy and Pin as primary. I'll update the Figma and drop a screenshot. Marcus (Product): One more ask: change the tooltip copy to include the short id (first 8 chars) after the label, e.g., "Copy Request ID 4a7f3b2c" — saves a glance. Sam (Accessibility): Tooltips are not accessible by keyboard by default. Make sure the tooltip text is replicated in aria-label or aria-describedby when focused via keyboard. Riley (Eng Runtime): Implementation sketch for dev: ``` Request ID 4a7f3b2c4d9e copied to clipboard when activated ``` Ava (Design): That looks good. For the snackbar microcopy I'll propose: 'Request ID copied · Open permalink' where the dot is a simple separator. Keep the copy length under 40 chars. Sam (Accessibility): Also verify color contrast of the toolbar icons and the tooltip background against dark mode. Tooltips often fall below 4.5:1 for small text. If tooltip text is smaller than 18/14 bold, aim for 7:1. Marcus (Product): Logistics: Riley, can you estimate effort? If quick, we'd ship this week as part of the compact toolbar polish. If not, next sprint. Riley (Eng Runtime): Estimation: ~1.5 dev days to implement toolbar changes + keyboard behavior + snackbar. Another 1 day for a11y review and small QA. We can bundle it in the next patch release. Ava (Design): I'll attach Figma updates and call out exact icon spacing and hit target sizes (minimum 44px tap). ci-bot: Deploy queued — patch window opens in 2h. :gear: (automated note) Marcus (Product): Perfect. I'll approve the copy tweaks once Figma is up. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
